# Mohawk Valley Community College (MVCC)

> Mohawk Valley Community College is a SUNY institution offering degree programs, certificates, and microcredentials with support for prospective, international, and adult learners.

MVCC serves the Utica area and beyond with comprehensive academic programs across multiple disciplines, robust student support services, and flexible learning options including online education. The college emphasizes accessibility, community engagement, and career pathways through its various schools and support initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Admissions
- Prospective Students
- Degree Programs
- Certificate Programs
- International Students
- Academic Advising
- Campus Life
- Scholarships
- Online Learning

- SUNY
- Registration
- Campus Visit
- Adult Learners

## Admissions & Prospective Students

- [Prospective Students Home](https://www.mvcc.edu/prospective-students/index.php): Gateway for prospective students to explore MVCC programs and admissions.
- [Admissions](https://www.mvcc.edu/admissions/index.php): Main admissions page for MVCC with application and campus visit info.
- [Application](https://www.mvcc.edu/admissions/application.php): MVCC application process guide for matriculated and international students.
- [Campus Visit](https://www.mvcc.edu/admissions/visit/index.php): Campus visit scheduling, tours, and information sessions for prospective students.
- [International Students](https://www.mvcc.edu/international/index.php): International student admissions, visas, and support at MVCC.

## Academic Programs & Pathways

- [MVCC Academics](https://www.mvcc.edu/academics/index.php): MVCC academic schools, programs, and career pathways overview.
- [Program List](https://catalog.mvcc.edu/current/programs/index.php): Complete directory of MVCC degree and certificate programs.
- [Microcredentials Home](https://www.mvcc.edu/microcredentials/index.php): MVCC microcredentials and non-degree skill development programs.

- [Online Learning](https://www.mvcc.edu/academics/online/index.php): MVCC online learning resources, technology, and distance education support.
